implementation_defaults.e4_conditions: one unchanged control and seven target classes x half-share / one-tenth-share
implementation_defaults.e4_control_parameters: reuse exact compatible E3 generator/real-learner controls; for other clean controls import successful frozen E1 selected parameters and refit in E4, or tune an E4-owned control where E1 failed; altered direct methods tune on each altered fitting cohort; each restoration treatment is separately tuned with the same learner-specific domain, clean tuning rows, and fixed 10-trial budget
implementation_defaults.e4_oversampling: restore target to original share; oversampling, SMOTE, generated methods receive same added target count and final histogram
implementation_defaults.e4_smote_neighbors: min(5,n_target-1), unsupported below two target rows
implementation_defaults.e4_treatment_materialization: one shared weighted/ros/smote cohort artifact per altered condition; one generated append per generator/condition shared across learners
implementation_defaults.e5_corruption: only fitting rows; clean tuning/calibration/test; clean-selected hyperparameters frozen and each refit inherits the matching clean route seed
implementation_defaults.e6_weight_selection: one global simplex vector per repetition, tuning balanced accuracy only
